**Installing:** download the original game disc ([IRON MAIDEN.iso](https://archive.org/download/fantatech/IRON%20MAIDEN.iso)), then drop it on `fantatech.exe` (Windows) or run `./fantatech --install "IRON MAIDEN.iso"` (Linux). After that, start `fantatech` with no arguments.

The builds aren't code-signed, so Windows may warn before the first start. Each archive comes with a build attestation; see the README's Security section to verify it.
